 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

As Sonar’s Marketing AI Engineer, you design, build, and maintain the AI agents and automated workflows that multiply the impact of the marketing function. You spend time with marketing stakeholders to understand their work in depth, identify where automation creates real leverage, and then build and iterate until it works well. You produce clear reporting on efficiency and impact, keeping marketing leadership informed on what the automations are actually delivering.

The best person for this role might be a marketing ops veteran who has taught themselves to build with AI, or an automation engineer who has gone deep on how marketing actually works. Either way, what matters is the combination: you understand marketing processes from the inside, and you can build reliable automations that make those processes faster, smarter, and more scalable.

What you will do

•
 Map and prioritize automation opportunities: Work closely with marketing teams to develop a deep understanding of their day-to-day processes — identifying where AI agents and automated workflows can eliminate manual work, reduce errors, or unlock capabilities that weren’t previously possible.

•
 Design and build AI agents: Develop AI agents and automated workflows that streamline marketing processes — from content production and campaign operations to reporting, lead routing, and personalization at scale.

•
 Deploy and maintain automations: Own the full lifecycle of deployed agents — from initial release through ongoing monitoring, debugging, and iteration — ensuring reliability and performance as usage grows.

•
 Produce efficiency and impact reporting: Track and report on workflow automation metrics — time saved, error rates, throughput, and business impact — delivering regular dashboards and summaries to marketing leadership.

•
 Stay current on AI tooling: Continuously evaluate new AI models, agent frameworks, and automation platforms — bringing a clear point of view on what Sonar marketing should adopt, experiment with, or build on next.

•
 Partner with Marketing Tooling & AI Operations: Collaborate closely with the Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager to understand the existing tool stack, ensure automations integrate reliably with it, and drive adoption of new AI-powered capabilities.

•
 Ensure data quality and governance: Design automations that handle marketing data responsibly — with attention to data quality, privacy, and auditability across all deployed workflows.

•
 Document and enable: Produce clear documentation for all deployed agents and workflows, and run internal enablement sessions to help the marketing team understand and effectively use what you have built.

Experience and qualifications

•
 Have 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, automation engineering, or a closely related role — with a track record of building workflows or automations that measurably improved team efficiency.

•
 Have deep, hands-on knowledge of marketing processes and tools — including CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation, campaign ops, analytics, and content workflows. A marketing ops practitioner who has grown into building automations is a strong fit.

•
 Be experienced with no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Make, Zapier, n8n) and comfortable extending them with scripting when needed (Python and/or JavaScript).

•
 Have working familiarity with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants) or a demonstrated ability and appetite to ramp quickly.

•
 Be experienced integrating with third-party APIs and working with marketing data structures (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo).

•
 Have strong analytical skills and experience building performance dashboards and reporting for deployed automations.

•
 Be a clear communicator who can explain what an automation does — and why it matters — to non-technical stakeholders, and translate their requirements into precise technical specifications.

•
 Bring intellectual curiosity and a bias to build — you stay current on the fast-moving AI landscape and bring that knowledge into your everyday work.

•
 Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

In-office culture

We’re intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that’s not where you are today, we’re happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com.

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Wer ist Sonar?

Sonar treibt die Zukunft der agentenzentrierten Softwareentwicklung voran. Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich der Überprüfung und Verifizierung von KI-Codes lösen wir ein entscheidendes Problem: sicherzustellen, dass Software, die von KI-unterstützten Entwicklern oder autonomen Agenten erstellt wird, zuverlässig, sicher und wartbar ist.

Durch die nahtlose Integration mit Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini und Devin helfen wir über 75% der Fortune 100 dabei, vertrauenswürdige, zuverlässige und konforme Software zu erstellen. Kunden, die Sonar verwenden, haben eine um 44% geringere Wahrscheinlichkeit, einen Ausfall aufgrund von AI-generiertem Code zu melden.

Wir glauben, dass die Codeverifizierung das kritische fehlende Glied im Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC) ist. Branchenriesen wie Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca und Ford Motor Company zählen darauf, dass wir eine unabhängige, erklärbare, konsistente Überprüfung und Governance ihres KI-generierten Codes über Produkte wie:

•
SonarQube: Die weltweit führende Plattform für die Überprüfung und Verifizierung von KI-Codes.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Derzeit Spitzenreiter bei der Reparatur von Agentic-Software.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Die Bereitstellung von Kontexten und Einschränkungen für Unternehmen muss wirklich effektiv sein.

Unser Team ist in globalen Hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Genf, London, Singapur, Tokio und Washington D.C. tätig. Wir bewegen uns mit einer Denkweise, die wir CODE nennen:

•
Unseren Kunden und der Community verpflichtet.

•
Besessen von Qualität.

•
Absichtlich in unseren Entscheidungen.

•
Effektiv als ein Team.

Mit über 400 Millionen US-Dollar Umsatz und profitablem, schnellem Wachstum bauen wir das Rückgrat der KI-Software-Revolution auf. Wenn Sie hungrig sind, etwas zu bewirken, schnell bauen und bereit sind, an der Spitze der KI zu arbeiten, möchten wir von Ihnen hören.

Positionsbeschreibung

Als Marketing AI Engineer von Sonar entwerfen, bauen und warten Sie die KI-Agenten und automatisierten Workflows, die die Auswirkungen der Marketingfunktion vervielfachen. Sie verbringen Zeit mit Marketing-Stakeholdern, um ihre Arbeit eingehend zu verstehen, herauszufinden, wo die Automatisierung echte Hebelwirkung schafft, und dann zu bauen und zu iterieren, bis es gut funktioniert. Sie erstellen eine klare Berichterstattung über Effizienz und Auswirkungen und halten die Marketingleitung darüber informiert, was die Automatisierungen tatsächlich liefern.

Die beste Person für diese Rolle könnte ein Marketing-Ops-Veteran sein, der sich selbst beigebracht hat, mit KI zu bauen, oder ein Automatisierungsingenieur, der sich eingehend damit beschäftigt hat, wie Marketing tatsächlich funktioniert. In jedem Fall kommt es auf die Kombination an: Sie verstehen Marketingprozesse von innen und können zuverlässige Automatisierungen erstellen, die diese Prozesse schneller, intelligenter und skalierbarer machen.

Was du tun wirst

•
Planen und priorisieren Sie Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Marketingteams zusammen, um ein tiefes Verständnis ihrer täglichen Prozesse zu entwickeln – und ermitteln Sie, wo KI-Agenten und automatisierte Workflows manuelle Arbeit eliminieren, Fehler reduzieren oder Funktionen freischalten können, die zuvor nicht möglich waren.

•
Entwerfen und Erstellen von KI-Agenten: Entwickeln Sie KI-Agenten und automatisierte Workflows, die Marketingprozesse optimieren - von der Content-Produktion und Kampagnenoperationen bis hin zu Reporting, Lead-Routing und Personalisierung in großem Maßstab.

•
Bereitstellung und Wartung von Automatisierungen: Besitzen Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus der bereitgestellten Agenten - von der ersten Veröffentlichung über die laufende Überwachung, das Debuggen und die Iteration - und gewährleisten Sie Zuverlässigkeit und Leistung bei wachsender Nutzung.

•
Erstellen von Effizienz- und Impact-Reporting: Verfolgen und Berichten über Workflow-Automatisierungsmetriken - Zeiteinsparungen, Fehlerquoten, Durchsatz und Geschäftsauswirkungen - und liefern regelmäßige Dashboards und Zusammenfassungen an die Marketingleitung.

•
Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über KI-Tools: Evaluieren Sie kontinuierlich neue KI-Modelle, Agenten-Frameworks und Automatisierungsplattformen und bringen Sie einen klaren Standpunkt dazu, was Sonar-Marketing als nächstes übernehmen, experimentieren oder darauf aufbauen sollte.

•
Partnerschaft mit Marketing Tooling & AI Operations: Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager zusammen, um den vorhandenen Werkzeugstapel zu verstehen, sicherzustellen, dass Automatisierungen zuverlässig in ihn integriert werden und die Einführung neuer KI-basierter Funktionen vorantreiben.

•
Datenqualität und Governance sicherstellen: Entwerfen Sie Automatisierungen, die verantwortungsvoll mit Marketingdaten umgehen – mit Blick auf Datenqualität, Datenschutz und Auditierbarkeit in allen bereitgestellten Workflows.

•
Dokumentieren und aktivieren: Erstellen Sie eine übersichtliche Dokumentation für alle bereitgestellten Agenten und Workflows und führen Sie interne Aktivierungssitzungen durch, um dem Marketingteam zu helfen, das von Ihnen Erstellte zu verstehen und effektiv zu nutzen.

Erfahrung und Qualifikationen

•
Haben Sie mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Marketing-Operationen, Automatisierungstechnik oder einer eng verwandten Rolle - mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Erstellung von Workflows oder Automatisierungen, die die Teameffizienz messbar verbessert haben.

•
Haben Sie ein tiefes, praktisches Wissen über Marketingprozesse und Tools - einschließlich CRM (Salesforce), Marketing-Automatisierung, Kampagnen-Ops, Analysen und Content-Workflows. Ein Marketing-Ops-Praktiker, der zu Gebäudeautomationen gewachsen ist, passt gut zusammen.

•
Erfahren Sie mit No-Code / Low-Code-Automatisierungsplattformen (z. B. Make, Zapier, n8n) und erweitern Sie diese bei Bedarf bequem mit Skripting (Python und / oder JavaScript).

•
Vertrautheit mit KI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants) oder eine nachgewiesene Fähigkeit und Appetit, schnell zu rasen.

•
Erfahren Sie die Integration in APIs von Drittanbietern und die Arbeit mit Marketingdatenstrukturen (z. B. Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo).

•
Verfügen Sie über fundierte analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung beim Erstellen von Performance-Dashboards und Reporting für bereitgestellte Automatisierungen.

•
Seien Sie ein klarer Kommunikator, der nicht-technischen Stakeholdern erklären kann, was eine Automatisierung tut – und warum sie wichtig ist – und ihre Anforderungen in präzise technische Spezifikationen übersetzen kann.

•
Bringen Sie intellektuelle Neugier und eine Voreingenommenheit zum Aufbau - Sie bleiben auf dem neuesten Stand der sich schnell bewegenden KI-Landschaft und bringen dieses Wissen in Ihre tägliche Arbeit.

•
Halten Sie einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Marketing, Business, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich.

In-Office-Kultur

Das ist unsere Absicht. Wir glauben, dass die besten Teams gemeinsam im Raum gebaut werden. Drei Ankertage - montags, dienstags und donnerstags - schaffen den Kollaborationsrhythmus, der ein Hub-Office wert macht.

Die Kandidaten müssen wirklich an dem Ort ansässig sein, an dem die Rolle veröffentlicht wird - wenn Sie heute nicht dort sind, unterstützen wir gerne den Umzug für die richtige Person.

Wir legen Wert auf Vielfalt, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion

Bei Sonar glauben wir, dass unsere Vielfalt unsere Stärke ist. Wir sind ein globales Unternehmen, das unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Kulturen schätzt und respektiert. Wir setzen uns für ein vielfältiges und integratives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich jeder geschätzt und befähigt fühlt, sein Bestes zu geben. Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit zu sein und begrüßen alle qualifizierten Bewerber, unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, nationaler Herkunft, Genetik, Behinderung, Alter oder Veteranenstatus.

Wenn Sie eine Unterkunft benötigen, kontaktieren Sie uns bitte unter hiring@sonarsource.com.

Alle Beschäftigungsangebote bei Sonar hängen von den Ergebnissen einer umfassenden Hintergrundprüfung und Referenzüberprüfung ab, die vor dem Startdatum durchgeführt wurden.

Bewerbungen, die über Agenturen oder Drittanbieter eingereicht werden, werden nicht berücksichtigt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Qui est Sonar ?

Sonar dirige l'avenir du développement de logiciels centrés sur les agents. En tant que leader de l'examen et de la vérification des codes d'IA, nous résolvons un problème critique : veiller à ce que les logiciels générés par les développeurs assistés par AI ou les agents autonomes soient fiables, sécurisés et durables.

En s'intégrant parfaitement avec Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini et Devin, nous aidons plus de 75% des logiciels de construction Fortune 100 fiables, conformes. Les clients qui utilisent Sonar sont 44 % moins susceptibles de signaler une panne en raison du code généré par l'IA.

Nous croyons que la vérification du code est le lien manquant essentiel dans le cycle de développement Agent-Centric (AC/DC). Les géants de l'industrie comme Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca et Ford Motor Company comptent sur nous pour fournir un examen indépendant, explicable, cohérent et la gouvernance de leur code généré par l'IA via des produits comme:

•
SonarQube: Le monde est la principale plate-forme de révision et de vérification de code AI.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: En ce moment, les classements pour la réparation de logiciels mandataires.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Contexte Augmentation : fournir le contexte de qualité entreprise et les agents de contraintes doivent être vraiment efficaces.

Notre équipe opère à travers des centres mondiaux à Austin, Bochum, Dubaï, Genève, Londres, Singapour, Tokyo et Washington D.C. Nous bougeons avec un état d'esprit que nous appelons CODE:

•
Engagement envers nos clients et notre communauté.

•
Obsédé par la qualité.

•
Délibérer dans nos décisions.

•
Efficace comme une seule équipe.

Avec plus de 400 M$ de revenus et une croissance rentable et rapide, nous construisons l'épine dorsale de la révolution logicielle de l'IA. Si vous avez faim d'avoir un impact, voulez construire à un rythme rapide, et prêt à travailler à l'avant-garde de l'IA, nous voulons entendre de vous.

Description de la position

En tant qu'Ingénieur Marketing AI de Sonar, vous concevez, construisez et maintenez les agents AI et les workflows automatisés qui multiplient l'impact de la fonction marketing. Vous passez du temps avec les intervenants du marketing pour comprendre leur travail en profondeur, identifier où l'automatisation crée un réel levier, puis construire et itérer jusqu'à ce qu'il fonctionne bien. Vous produisez des rapports clairs sur l'efficacité et l'impact, en gardant le leadership du marketing informé sur ce que les automatismes fournissent réellement.

La meilleure personne pour ce rôle pourrait être un vétéran des opérations de marketing qui s'est appris à construire avec l'IA, ou un ingénieur d'automatisation qui a approfondi sur comment le marketing fonctionne réellement. De toute façon, ce qui compte, c'est la combinaison: vous comprenez les processus marketing de l'intérieur, et vous pouvez construire des automatismes fiables qui rendent ces processus plus rapides, plus intelligents et plus évolutives.

Ce que vous ferez

•
Planifier et prioriser les possibilités d'automatisation : Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de marketing pour développer une compréhension approfondie de leurs processus quotidiens – identifier où les agents d'IA et les workflows automatisés peuvent éliminer le travail manuel, réduire les erreurs ou débloquer des capacités qui n'étaient pas auparavant possibles.

•
Concevoir et construire des agents d'IA : Développer des agents d'IA et des workflows automatisés qui simplifient les processus de marketing, de la production de contenu et des opérations de campagne à la production de rapports, à l'acheminement et à la personnalisation à grande échelle.

•
Déployer et maintenir les automatismes: Posséder le cycle de vie complet des agents déployés — de la libération initiale à la surveillance continue, au débogage et à l'itération — en assurant la fiabilité et les performances à mesure que l'utilisation augmente.

•
Produire des rapports sur l'efficacité et l'impact : suivre et rendre compte des mesures d'automatisation des flux de travail - gain de temps, taux d'erreurs, débit et impact sur les entreprises - fournir régulièrement des tableaux de bord et des résumés aux responsables du marketing.

•
Restez à jour sur l'outil d'IA: évaluez en permanence les nouveaux modèles d'IA, les cadres d'agents et les plates-formes d'automatisation, en apportant un point de vue clair sur ce que le marketing Sonar devrait adopter, expérimenter ou construire.

•
Collaborez étroitement avec le Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager afin de comprendre la pile d'outils existante, de s'assurer que les automatismes s'intègrent de façon fiable avec elle et d'encourager l'adoption de nouvelles capacités d'IA.

•
Assurer la qualité et la gouvernance des données: concevoir des automatisations qui traitent les données de marketing de manière responsable, en accordant une attention particulière à la qualité des données, à la confidentialité et à la vérification de tous les flux de travail déployés.

•
Documenter et activer : Produire une documentation claire pour tous les agents déployés et les workflows, et exécuter des sessions d'activation internes pour aider l'équipe marketing à comprendre et utiliser efficacement ce que vous avez construit.

Expérience et qualifications

•
Avoir plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans les opérations de marketing, l'ingénierie d'automatisation ou un rôle étroitement lié, avec une expérience de construction de workflows ou d'automatisations qui a amélioré de façon mesurable l'efficacité de l'équipe.

•
Avoir une connaissance approfondie et pratique des processus et des outils de marketing, y compris le CRM (Salesforce), l'automatisation du marketing, les opérations de campagne, l'analyse et les flux de travail de contenu. Un praticien du marketing qui est devenu l'automatisation du bâtiment est un bon choix.

•
Être expérimenté avec des plates-formes d'automatisation sans code/faible code (p. ex., Make, Zapier, n8n) et confortablement les étendre avec scriptage au besoin (Python et/ou JavaScript).

•
Avoir une connaissance pratique des cadres d'agents d'IA (p. ex. LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants) ou une capacité et un appétit démontrés pour se lancer rapidement.

•
Être expérimentée dans l'intégration avec des API tierces et travailler avec des structures de données de marketing (par exemple, Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo).

•
Avoir de solides compétences analytiques et de l'expérience en matière d'élaboration de tableaux de bord et de rapports de performance pour les automatisations déployées.

•
Être un communicateur clair qui peut expliquer ce qu'une automatisation fait — et pourquoi elle importe — aux acteurs non techniques, et traduire leurs exigences en spécifications techniques précises.

•
Apportez une curiosité intellectuelle et un biais à construire — vous restez à jour sur le paysage de l'IA qui évolue rapidement et apportez cette connaissance dans votre travail quotidien.

•
Être titulaire d'un baccalauréat en marketing, en affaires, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.

Culture interne

Nous sommes intentionnels. Nous croyons que les meilleures équipes sont construites dans la pièce ensemble. Trois jours d'ancrage — les lundis, les mardis et les jeudis — créent le rythme de collaboration qui rend un bureau central intéressant.

Les candidats doivent être véritablement basés dans l'endroit où le rôle est affiché — si ce n'est pas là où vous êtes aujourd'hui, nous sommes heureux de soutenir la réinstallation pour la bonne personne.

Nous apprécions la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion

Chez Sonar, nous croyons que notre diversité est notre force. Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale qui valorise et respecte différents horizons, perspectives et cultures. Nous sommes déterminés à favoriser un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé et habilité à contribuer le mieux possible. Nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur sur un pied d'égalité et d'accueillir tous les candidats qualifiés, peu importe la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'identité ou l'expression de genre, l'orientation sexuelle, l'origine nationale, la génétique, le handicap, l'âge ou le statut de vétéran.

Si vous avez besoin d'un logement, veuillez communiquer avec nous à l'adresse suivante : embauche@sonarsource.com.

Toutes les offres d'emploi chez Sonar dépendent des résultats d'une vérification complète des antécédents et des références effectuée avant la date de début.

Les demandes présentées par des organismes ou des tiers recruteurs ne seront pas prises en considération.

jobs.title: Major Incident Management
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

Position description

As Manager of Major Incident Management, you will own how Sonar prevents, responds to, and learns from incidents across its critical systems. You will drive the Incident Management, Change Management, and Problem Management programs through a data-driven, risk-based approach — ensuring that prioritization is guided by measurable impact rather than reactive urgency. By building clear operational health metrics and delivering consistent visibility into service reliability, change risk, and systemic patterns, you will give leadership the insight they need to make confident decisions and you will give your team the clarity they need to focus on what matters most.

What you will do

•
 Lead the Incident, Change, and Problem Management programs end-to-end, applying a risk-based framework to prioritize efforts across the company where they reduce the most organizational risk

•
 Define, maintain, and report on operational health metrics that provide clear, ongoing visibility into service availability, incident trends, change success rates, and residual risk

•
 Deliver regular operational reporting to leadership, surfacing systemic patterns, unresolved follow-ups, and areas of elevated risk with clear recommendations

•
 Coach and develop a team of Major Incident Managers, setting clear expectations for structured incident command, stakeholder communication, and post-incident follow-through

•
 Own the Post-Incident Review process, ensuring blameless, high-quality analysis that turns findings into prioritized problem records and measurable improvements

•
 Own and continuously improve the Change Management process, balancing delivery speed with risk reduction through clear classification, approval, and review standards

•
 Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, and Mission Control to align on risk appetite, reduce time to mitigation, and ensure change governance supports the product roadmap

•
 Use incident, problem, and change data to identify recurring failures, weak controls, and systemic causes — driving prioritization of corrective actions based on strategic impact

Experience and qualifications

•
 5-8 years of experience managing teams who deliver Major Incident Management and Problem Management functions within multinational, distributed companies

•
 Proven people management experience leading operational or incident-focused teams (e.g., Incident Managers, SRE, NOC/Command Center)

•
 Track record of defining operational metrics and building reporting that gives leadership clear visibility into operational health and risk

•
 Strong understanding of ITIL or similar service management frameworks (Incident, Problem, and Change Management), applied pragmatically in modern engineering organizations

•
 Demonstrated ability to lead critical incidents under pressure with structure, clarity, and calm decision-making

•
 Experience establishing or maturing post-incident review practices and translating findings into systemic improvements

•
 Familiarity with Atlassian products and ITSM platforms (e.g., Jira Service Management, Confluence, Statuspage)

•
 Experience using or developing AI tooling to enhance correlation, accuracy, and speed for outage resolution and problem management

•
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to tailor messages to executives, engineers, and non-technical stakeholders

Additional comments

This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

Position description

As Manager of Major Incident Management, you will own how Sonar prevents, responds to, and learns from incidents across its critical systems. You will drive the Incident Management, Change Management, and Problem Management programs through a data-driven, risk-based approach — ensuring that prioritization is guided by measurable impact rather than reactive urgency. By building clear operational health metrics and delivering consistent visibility into service reliability, change risk, and systemic patterns, you will give leadership the insight they need to make confident decisions and you will give your team the clarity they need to focus on what matters most.

What you will do

•
 Lead the Incident, Change, and Problem Management programs end-to-end, applying a risk-based framework to prioritize efforts across the company where they reduce the most organizational risk

•
 Define, maintain, and report on operational health metrics that provide clear, ongoing visibility into service availability, incident trends, change success rates, and residual risk

•
 Deliver regular operational reporting to leadership, surfacing systemic patterns, unresolved follow-ups, and areas of elevated risk with clear recommendations

•
 Coach and develop a team of Major Incident Managers, setting clear expectations for structured incident command, stakeholder communication, and post-incident follow-through

•
 Own the Post-Incident Review process, ensuring blameless, high-quality analysis that turns findings into prioritized problem records and measurable improvements

•
 Own and continuously improve the Change Management process, balancing delivery speed with risk reduction through clear classification, approval, and review standards

•
 Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, and Mission Control to align on risk appetite, reduce time to mitigation, and ensure change governance supports the product roadmap

•
 Use incident, problem, and change data to identify recurring failures, weak controls, and systemic causes — driving prioritization of corrective actions based on strategic impact

 5-8 years of experience managing teams who deliver Major Incident Management and Problem Management functions within multinational, distributed companies

 Track record of defining operational metrics and building reporting that gives leadership clear visibility into operational health and risk

•
 Strong understanding of ITIL or similar service management frameworks (Incident, Problem, and Change Management), applied pragmatically in modern engineering organizations

 Demonstrated ability to lead critical incidents under pressure with structure, clarity, and calm decision-making

•
 Experience establishing or maturing post-incident review practices and translating findings into systemic improvements

•
 Familiarity with Atlassian products and ITSM platforms (e.g., Jira Service Management, Confluence, Statuspage)

•
 Experience using or developing AI tooling to enhance correlation, accuracy, and speed for outage resolution and problem management

•
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to tailor messages to executives, engineers, and non-technical stakeholders

Erfahrung mit oder Entwicklung von KI-Tools zur Verbesserung von Korrelation, Genauigkeit und Geschwindigkeit für die Ausfalllösung und das Problemmanagement

Hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, mit der Fähigkeit, Nachrichten an Führungskräfte, Ingenieure und nicht-technische Interessengruppen anzupassen

Diriger les programmes de gestion des incidents, des changements et des problèmes de bout en bout, en appliquant un cadre axé sur les risques pour prioriser les efforts dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise où ils réduisent le risque organisationnel le plus élevé

Améliorer en permanence le processus de gestion du changement, en conciliant la rapidité d'exécution et la réduction des risques grâce à des normes claires de classification, d'approbation et d'examen

S'associer à l'ingénierie, aux produits, à la sécurité et au contrôle de la mission pour s'aligner sur l'appétit pour les risques, réduire le temps nécessaire à l'atténuation et veiller à ce que la gouvernance du changement appuie la feuille de route du produit

Utiliser des données sur les incidents, les problèmes et les changements pour déceler les défaillances récurrentes, les faiblesses des contrôles et les causes systémiques, ce qui détermine la priorité des mesures correctives fondées sur l'impact stratégique

jobs.title: Identity Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

Position description

Sonar is looking for a customer-centric Identity Product Manager to drive the authentication, authorization, and access management capabilities that let every user, from an individual developer to the largest regulated enterprise, get into Sonar products securely and without friction. You will work with the Identity squad, in the Storefront domain, which provides the operational foundation enabling seamless customer access to Sonar's products, underpinning core business processes such as billing and entitlement.

This role sits at the intersection of customer experience, security, and compliance. As a Product Manager, you will shape how organizations authenticate into Sonar (SSO via SAML/OIDC, with enterprise identity providers such as Okta and Entra ID), how permissions and roles are managed at scale, and how user and organization identities are provisioned and kept secure throughout their lifecycle. To achieve this, we need a passionate Product Manager who will research, clarify, and prioritize the needs of external IT administrators, security teams, and enterprise buyers, and translate those needs across our product line.

You will join the Product Management team, composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. You will also work closely with the Identity engineering teams to ensure that proposed solutions meet the expected outcome, and that we collectively deliver an identity experience that is both secure by default and simple for administrators to operate at scale.

By joining us, you will bring your deep knowledge of identity and access management (SSO, IdP integrations, RBAC/permissions, user provisioning) and your experience as a Product Manager to help us reach the next level and provide a trusted, frictionless experience to millions of developers and thousands of enterprise administrators.

What you will do

•
 Contribute to the different areas of the Identity vision and communicate about them, internally and externally.

•
 Research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities to build and maintain an effective roadmap, focused on enterprise-grade authentication, authorization, and access management.

•
 Interact directly with our users and customers to support them, integrate their feedback, and identify opportunities.

•
 Develop a deep understanding of enterprise identity needs (e.g., SSO/SAML/OIDC, IdP integrations such as Okta and Entra ID, SCIM/user provisioning, and fine-grained permissions) and how we can enable organizations to onboard and administer users at scale.

•
 Drive modernization of enterprise identity and access management, including expanding IdP support and hardening permissions and role management for the largest, most complex organizations.

•
 Work closely with other product managers to design cross-product features.

•
 Align with the engineering and UX teams on the problems to solve and support them during the end-to-end development stage of the solutions.

•
 Sync with the engineering teams to ensure that there is a good balance between innovation, consolidation, and stability.

•
 Attend conferences and give talks if you like.

•
 Help the Product Management team grow in its organization, tools, and processes.

Experience and qualifications

•
 Passionate about identity and access management, and the practices that lead to seamless and secure authentication systems.

•
 Deep understanding of identity protocols and patterns (e.g., SAML, OIDC/OAuth2, SSO, SCIM/provisioning, JWT) and enterprise identity providers (Okta, Entra ID/Azure AD, or similar).

•
 Technical comprehension of permissions and access control models (RBAC/ABAC) and multi-tenant SaaS access control.

•
 Understanding of the compliance and security expectations of enterprise buyers (e.g., SOC 2) as they relate to identity and access.

•
 Experience with the latest developments in AI assisted coding.

•
 Experience in software product management, preferably managing identity in an agile context.

•
 Highly autonomous and pragmatic, with an obsession for solving external customer problems.

•
 Open-minded and very positive can-do attitude.

•
 Comfortable in dealing with change, complexity, and uncertainty.

•
 Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo as well as to receive feedback.

•

Crediamo che la verifica del codice sia il collegamento mancante fondamentale nel Ciclo di Sviluppo Agent-Centric (AC/DC). I giganti del settore come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company contano su di noi per fornire una revisione indipendente, spiegabile, coerente e la governance del loro codice generato dall'IA attraverso prodotti come:

• SonarQube: la piattaforma leader mondiale per la revisione e la verifica del codice AI.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Attualmente il lancio delle classifiche per la riparazione di software agentic.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Fornire il contesto di livello enterprise e gli agenti vincoli devono essere veramente efficaci.

Il nostro team opera in tutto il mondo a Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington D.C. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODE:

• Impegnati ai nostri clienti e comunità.

• Obsessed con qualità.

• Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.

• Efficace come una squadra.

Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te.

Descrizione della posizione

Sonar è alla ricerca di un Product Manager Identity focalizzato sul cliente per guidare le capacità di autenticazione, autorizzazione e gestione degli accessi che permettono a ogni utente, da uno sviluppatore individuale alla più grande impresa regolamentata, entrare in prodotti Sonar in modo sicuro e senza attrito. Potrai lavorare con la squadra Identity, nel dominio Storefront, che fornisce la fondazione operativa che consente l'accesso senza soluzione di continuità ai prodotti Sonar, sottolineando processi aziendali fondamentali come fatturazione e diritto.

Questo ruolo si trova all'incrocio tra l'esperienza del cliente, la sicurezza e la conformità. Come Product Manager, formerai come le organizzazioni autenticheranno a Sonar (SSO via SAML/OIDC, con fornitori di identità aziendali come Okta e Entra ID), come i permessi e i ruoli vengono gestiti in scala, e come le identità utente e organizzativa sono fornite e mantenute sicure durante il loro ciclo di vita. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, abbiamo bisogno di un Product Manager appassionato che cercherà, chiarirà e prioritizzerà le esigenze degli amministratori IT esterni, dei team di sicurezza e degli acquirenti aziendali, e tradurrà tali esigenze attraverso la nostra linea di prodotti.

Ti unirai al team Product Management, composto da altri appassionati Product Manager desiderosi di collaborare con te. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di ingegneria Identity per garantire che le soluzioni proposte soddisfino il risultato previsto, e che forniamo collettivamente un'esperienza di identità che sia sicura per impostazione predefinita e semplice per gli amministratori di operare in scala.

Unindosi a noi, si porterà la vostra profonda conoscenza dell'identità e della gestione degli accessi (SSO, integrazioni IdP, RBAC/permissioni, provisioning degli utenti) e la vostra esperienza come Product Manager per aiutarci a raggiungere il livello successivo e fornire un'esperienza affidabile e senza attriti a milioni di sviluppatori e migliaia di amministratori aziendali.

Contribuire alle diverse aree della visione dell'identità e comunicare su di loro, internamente ed esternamente.

•
Ricerca, chiarimento e priorità opportunità di costruire e mantenere una roadmap efficace, focalizzata sull'autenticazione, l'autorizzazione e la gestione degli accessi.

Interagisci direttamente con i nostri utenti e clienti per supportarli, integrare il loro feedback e identificare le opportunità.

•
Sviluppare una profonda comprensione delle esigenze dell'identità aziendale (ad esempio, SSO/SAML/OIDC, integrazioni IdP come Okta e Entra ID, provisioning SCIM/user e autorizzazioni in grana fine) e come possiamo consentire alle organizzazioni di salire a bordo e amministrare gli utenti in scala.

•
Guidare l'ammodernamento dell'identità aziendale e la gestione degli accessi, tra cui l'espansione del supporto IdP e i permessi di indurimento e la gestione del ruolo per le organizzazioni più grandi e complesse.

•

•
Allineare con i team di ingegneria e UX sui problemi di risolvere e supportarli durante la fase di sviluppo end-to-end delle soluzioni.

•
Sincronizza con i team di ingegneria per garantire un buon equilibrio tra innovazione, consolidamento e stabilità.

•
Partecipa a conferenze e fai colloqui, se vuoi.

•
Aiuta il team di Product Management a crescere nella sua organizzazione, strumenti e processi.

Esperienza e qualifiche

•
Appassionato sulla gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso, e le pratiche che portano a sistemi di autenticazione senza soluzione di continuità e sicura.

•
Profonda comprensione dei protocolli e modelli di identità (ad esempio, SAML, OIDC/OAuth2, SSO, SCIM/provisioning, JWT) e provider di identità aziendali (Okta, Entra ID/Azure AD, o simili).

Comprensione tecnica delle autorizzazioni e dei modelli di controllo accessi (RBAC/ABAC) e controllo multi-tenant di accesso SaaS.

Comprendere le aspettative di conformità e di sicurezza degli acquirenti aziendali (ad esempio, SOC 2) in relazione all'identità e all'accesso.

Esperienza con gli ultimi sviluppi nella codifica assistita AI.

Esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti software, preferibilmente gestione dell'identità in un contesto agile.

Altamente autonomo e pragmatico, con un'ossessione per risolvere i problemi dei clienti esterni.

Atteggiamento can-do aperto e molto positivo.

Confortevole nel trattare il cambiamento, la complessità e l'incertezza.

abbastanza sicuro da sfidare lo status quo e ricevere feedback.

Cultura in ufficio

Siamo intenzionali. Crediamo che le migliori squadre siano costruite nella stanza insieme. Tre giorni di ancora — lunedì, martedì e giovedì — creano il ritmo di collaborazione che rende un hub office degno di avere.

I candidati devono essere autenticamente basati nel luogo in cui il ruolo è pubblicato — se non è lì che sei oggi, siamo lieti di sostenere la delocalizzazione per la persona giusta.

Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione

A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

Position description

Sonar is looking for a customer-centric Identity Product Manager to drive the authentication, authorization, and access management capabilities that let every user, from an individual developer to the largest regulated enterprise, get into Sonar products securely and without friction. You will work with the Identity squad, in the Storefront domain, which provides the operational foundation enabling seamless customer access to Sonar's products, underpinning core business processes such as billing and entitlement.

This role sits at the intersection of customer experience, security, and compliance. As a Product Manager, you will shape how organizations authenticate into Sonar (SSO via SAML/OIDC, with enterprise identity providers such as Okta and Entra ID), how permissions and roles are managed at scale, and how user and organization identities are provisioned and kept secure throughout their lifecycle. You will join the Product Management team, composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. You will also work closely with the Identity engineering teams to ensure that proposed solutions meet the expected outcome, and that we collectively deliver an identity experience that is both secure by default and simple for administrators to operate at scale.

By joining us, you will bring your deep knowledge of identity and access management (SSO, IdP integrations, RBAC/permissions, user provisioning) and your experience as a Product Manager to help us reach the next level and provide a trusted, frictionless experience to millions of developers and thousands of enterprise administrators.

 Help the Product Management team grow in its organization, tools, and processes.

Experience and qualifications

 Passionate about identity and access management, and the practices that lead to seamless and secure authentication systems.

•
Erforschen, klären und priorisieren Sie Möglichkeiten zum Erstellen und Pflegen einer effektiven Roadmap, die sich auf die Authentifizierung, Autorisierung und Zugriffsverwaltung auf Unternehmensebene konzentriert.

Entwickeln Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der Anforderungen an die Unternehmensidentität (z. B. SSO / SAML / OIDC, IdP-Integrationen wie Okta und Entra ID, SCIM / Benutzerbereitstellung und detaillierte Berechtigungen) und wie wir es Unternehmen ermöglichen können, Benutzer skalierbar einzubinden und zu verwalten.

Modernisierung des Enterprise Identity- und Access-Managements, einschließlich Erweiterung der IdP-Unterstützung und Härtung von Berechtigungen und Rollenmanagement für die größten und komplexesten Organisationen.

Arbeiten Sie eng mit anderen Produktmanagern zusammen, um produktübergreifende Funktionen zu entwerfen.

•
Richten Sie sich mit den Engineering- und UX-Teams an den Problemen aus, um sie während der End-to-End-Entwicklungsphase der Lösungen zu lösen und zu unterstützen.

Besuchen Sie Konferenzen und halten Sie Vorträge, wenn Sie möchten.

Erfahrung und Qualifikationen

Leidenschaft für Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement und die Praktiken, die zu nahtlosen und sicheren Authentifizierungssystemen führen.

Tiefes Verständnis von Identitätsprotokollen und -mustern (z. B. SAML, OIDC/OAuth2, SSO, SCIM/Provisioning, JWT) und Anbietern von Unternehmensidentitäten (Okta, Entra ID/Azure AD oder ähnliches).

Technisches Verständnis von Berechtigungen und Zugriffskontrollmodellen (RBAC/ABAC) und Multi-Tenant-SaaS-Zugriffskontrolle.

Verständnis der Compliance- und Sicherheitserwartungen von Unternehmenskäufern (z. B. SOC 2) in Bezug auf Identität und Zugriff.

Erfahrung mit den neuesten Entwicklungen in der KI-unterstützten Codierung.

Erfahrung im Software-Produktmanagement, vorzugsweise im Management von Identitäten im agilen Kontext.

Höchst autonom und pragmatisch, mit der Obsession, externe Kundenprobleme zu lösen.

Aufgeschlossene und sehr positive Can-Do-Haltung.

Bequem im Umgang mit Veränderung, Komplexität und Unsicherheit.

En tant que gestionnaire de produits, vous définirez comment les organisations s'authentifient en Sonar (SSO via SAML/OIDC, avec des fournisseurs d'identité d'entreprise comme Okta et Entra ID), comment les autorisations et les rôles sont gérés à l'échelle, et comment les identités d'utilisateur et d'organisation sont fournies et maintenues en sécurité tout au long de leur cycle de vie. Pour y parvenir, nous avons besoin d'un gestionnaire de produits passionné qui recherchera, clarifiera et priorisera les besoins des administrateurs informatiques externes, des équipes de sécurité et des acheteurs d'entreprise, et qui traduira ces besoins dans toute notre gamme de produits.

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe de gestion des produits, composée d'autres chefs de produits passionnés désireux de collaborer avec vous. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie d'identité pour s'assurer que les solutions proposées répondent au résultat attendu et que nous offrons collectivement une expérience d'identité à la fois sécurisée par défaut et simple pour les administrateurs à opérer à l'échelle.

En vous joignant à nous, vous apporterez votre connaissance approfondie de l'identité et de la gestion d'accès (SSO, intégrations IdP, RBAC/permissions, fourniture d'utilisateurs) et votre expérience en tant que Product Manager pour nous aider à atteindre le niveau suivant et fournir une expérience fiable et sans friction à des millions de développeurs et des milliers d'administrateurs d'entreprise.

Ce que vous ferez

•
Contribuer aux différents domaines de la vision d'identité et communiquer à leur sujet, à l'interne et à l'externe.

•
Recherche, clarification et hiérarchisation des occasions d'élaborer et de maintenir une feuille de route efficace, axée sur l'authentification, l'autorisation et la gestion de l'accès à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

•
Interagir directement avec nos utilisateurs et nos clients pour les soutenir, intégrer leurs commentaires et identifier les opportunités.

•
Développer une compréhension approfondie des besoins d'identité de l'entreprise (p. ex. SSO/SAML/OIDC, intégrations IdP telles que Okta et Entra ID, fourniture SCIM/utilisateur, et permissions à grain fin) et comment nous pouvons permettre aux organisations d'utiliser et d'administrer les utilisateurs à l'échelle.

•
Favoriser la modernisation de l'identité de l'entreprise et de la gestion de l'accès, y compris l'élargissement du soutien à l'IDP et le durcissement des autorisations et de la gestion des rôles pour les organisations les plus importantes et les plus complexes.

•
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec d'autres gestionnaires de produits pour concevoir des caractéristiques de produits croisés.

•
Alignez-vous avec les équipes d'ingénierie et d'UX sur les problèmes à résoudre et à soutenir pendant la phase de développement de bout en bout des solutions.

•
Synchroniser avec les équipes d'ingénierie pour assurer un bon équilibre entre innovation, consolidation et stabilité.

•
Assister à des conférences et donner des conférences si vous voulez.

•
Aider l'équipe de gestion des produits à croître dans son organisation, ses outils et ses processus.

Expérience et qualifications

•
Passionné par la gestion de l'identité et de l'accès, et les pratiques qui conduisent à des systèmes d'authentification transparents et sécurisés.

•
Connaissance approfondie des protocoles et des modèles d'identité (p. ex. SAML, OIDC/OAuth2, SSO, SCIM/provisionnement, JWT) et des fournisseurs d'identité d'entreprise (Okta, Entra ID/Azure AD, ou similaire).

•
Compréhension technique des autorisations et des modèles de contrôle d'accès (RBAC/ABAC) et du contrôle d'accès SaaS à plusieurs locataires.

•
Compréhension de la conformité et des attentes en matière de sécurité des acheteurs d'entreprises (p. ex., SOC 2) en ce qui concerne leur identité et leur accès.

•
Expérience des derniers développements en matière de codage assisté par AI.

•
Expérience en gestion de produits logiciels, de préférence en gestion de l'identité dans un contexte agile.

•
Très autonome et pragmatique, avec une obsession pour résoudre les problèmes externes de clients.

•
Une attitude ouverte et très positive.

•
Confortable face au changement, à la complexité et à l'incertitude.

•
Auto-confident suffisamment pour contester le statu quo ainsi que pour recevoir des commentaires.

•
Leadership : vous prenez des initiatives et démontrez votre capacité à diriger un sujet du début à la fin.

Culture interne

On est intentionnels. Nous croyons que les meilleures équipes sont construites dans la pièce ensemble. Trois jours d'ancrage — les lundis, les mardis et les jeudis — créent le rythme de collaboration qui rend un bureau central intéressant.

Les candidats doivent être vraiment basés dans l'endroit où le rôle est affiché — si ce n'est pas là où vous êtes aujourd'hui, nous sommes heureux d'appuyer la réinstallation pour la bonne personne.

Nous apprécions la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion

Chez Sonar, nous croyons que notre diversité est notre force. Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale qui valorise et respecte différents horizons, perspectives et cultures. Nous sommes déterminés à favoriser un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé et habilité à contribuer le mieux possible. Nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur sur un pied d'égalité et d'accueillir tous les candidats qualifiés, peu importe la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'identité ou l'expression de genre, l'orientation sexuelle, l'origine nationale, la génétique, le handicap, l'âge ou le statut de vétéran.

Si vous avez besoin d'un logement, veuillez communiquer avec nous à l'adresse embauche@sonarsource.com .

Toutes les offres d'emploi chez Sonar dépendent des résultats d'une vérification complète des antécédents et des références effectuée avant la date de début.

Les demandes présentées par des organismes ou des tiers recruteurs ne seront pas prises en considération.

jobs.title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

Position description

Identity is a critical dependency for how Sonar works. Our people need reliable access to the right systems, while the business needs confidence that access is appropriate, traceable, and removed when it is no longer required.

As a Staff Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer in our Systems Engineering squad, you will design, build, and operate the identity services that connect our workforce, enterprise applications, and infrastructure. You will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering to make identity secure, reliable, and straightforward to use.

You will shape the technical direction of workforce IAM, turn complex access requirements into maintainable engineering solutions, and lead initiatives from design through production operation. Your scope includes employee and external-worker identity lifecycles, authentication and federation, access governance, privileged access, and the non-human identities supporting our internal services and automation.

This is a technical leadership role without direct people-management responsibilities. You will work across IT Operations, Information Security, Business Technology, People Operations, and engineering teams to establish clear ownership, manage dependencies, and deliver improvements that remain effective as Sonar grows.

What you will do

• Identity architecture and technical direction: Assess our identity landscape, identify material risks and technical debt, and develop a prioritized IAM engineering roadmap with squad leadership and Information Security..

•
 Identity lifecycle engineering:. Connect authoritative workforce data to identity platforms and downstream applications, with reliable identity matching, reconciliation, expiry, and exception handling. End to end verification of deprovisioning outcomes

•
 Authentication and federation: Engineer and operate SSO, MFA, and application provisioning integrations using SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth, and SCIM. Advance phishing-resistant authentication and secure enrollment, recovery, and session-management practices. Manage federation certificates and other expiring dependencies before they disrupt access.

•
 Access governance: Own practical role- and attribute-based access models, approval workflows, access reviews, and time-bound exceptions. Make entitlements understandable and auditable, with named owners and appropriate separation of duties. Introduce next-gen automation to improve speed and accuracy of oversight.

•
 Automation and integration: Develop production-quality code, API integrations, and infrastructure-as-code to reduce manual administration. Build in testing, peer review, least-privileged execution, safe retries, reconciliation, and actionable failure reporting. Use AI-assisted engineering where useful, with human review and controls appropriate to the sensitivity of identity changes.

•
 Non-human identity: Partner with service owners to improve the inventory, ownership, permissions, credential rotation, and retirement of service accounts, application identities, and automation credentials.

•
 Reliability and operational ownership: Participate in the squad’s incident and escalation arrangements, diagnose complex failures, and deliver durable corrective actions.

•
 Security and auditability: Partner with Information Security and control owners to implement agreed controls, provide reliable evidence, and close findings through engineering improvements. Connect identity telemetry to security monitoring while protecting sensitive identity data.

•
 Technical leadership and enablement: Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and help application owners adopt supported identity patterns. Equip operational teams with documentation and tooling so routine requests do not depend on individual experts.

Experience and qualifications

• Substantial hands-on experience engineering and operating enterprise IAM services, with demonstrated impact: leading ambiguous, cross-team initiatives, making sound architectural trade-offs, and improving the effectiveness of other engineers.

•
 Deep experience with a modern workforce identity platform such as JumpCloud, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID. JumpCloud experience is valuable; equivalent platform expertise and the ability to learn are equally relevant.

•
 Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, federation, directories, and provisioning, including SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and WebAuthn/FIDO2.

•
 Proven delivery of automated identity lifecycle processes, including workforce-data integration, account correlation, access changes, and verified deprovisioning across multiple applications.

•
 Experience with cloud IAM and federated access, particularly AWS IAM and IAM Identity Center, including permission boundaries, temporary credentials, and least-privilege access patterns.

•
 Strong programming and automation skills in Python, PowerShell, Go, TypeScript, or a comparable language, together with REST APIs, Git-based delivery, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code.

•
 Practical experience with access governance, privileged access, secrets management, and producing evidence that demonstrates controls operate effectively.

•
 Experience operating business-critical services: observability, incident response, root-cause analysis, safe change management, and recovery testing.

Additional comments

This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi è Sonar?

Sonar consente alle organizzazioni di spedire codice agentico con fiducia. La creazione di codice è abbondante, ma la fiducia è scarsa. La nostra piattaforma centrale, SonarQube, verifica oltre 750 miliardi di linee di codice ogni giorno, offrendo verifica e governance agentiche per tutti i codici. Fiduciati da più di 7 milioni di sviluppatori e il 75% della Fortune 100, tra cui i team di Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company, Sonar consente alle organizzazioni di ridurre gli outage, migliorare la sicurezza e ridurre il costo e il rischio di sviluppo software agentico.

Fondata a Ginevra e ora con sede a Austin, Texas, Sonar ha un team globale che lavora tra uffici e hub, tra cui Silicon Valley, Londra, Bochum, Barcellona, Singapore, Tokyo e la zona di Washington, D.C.. A Sonar, stiamo consentendo alle aziende di costruire fabbriche software agentiche che possono muoversi rapidamente mantenendo il controllo, la coerenza e le prove necessarie per spedire con fiducia.

Descrizione della posizione

L'identità è una dipendenza critica per come funziona Sonar. Le nostre persone hanno bisogno di un accesso affidabile ai sistemi giusti, mentre l'azienda ha bisogno di fiducia che l'accesso sia appropriato, tracciabile e rimosso quando non è più necessario.

In qualità di Staff Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer nella nostra squadra di ingegneria dei sistemi, progetta, costruisce e gestisce i servizi di identità che collegano la nostra forza lavoro, applicazioni aziendali e infrastrutture. Si unirà profonda esperienza tecnica con ingegneria hands-on per rendere l'identità sicura, affidabile e semplice da usare.

Formerai la direzione tecnica della forza lavoro IAM, trasformerai i requisiti di accesso complessi in soluzioni ingegneristiche manutenbili e porterai iniziative dalla progettazione attraverso il funzionamento della produzione. Il vostro scopo include i cicli di vita dell'identità dei dipendenti e dei lavoratori esterni, l'autenticazione e la federazione, la governance dell'accesso, l'accesso privilegiato e le identità non umane che sostengono i nostri servizi interni e l'automazione.

Questo è un ruolo di leadership tecnica senza responsabilità dirette della gestione delle persone. Potrai lavorare in operazioni IT, sicurezza dell'informazione, tecnologia aziendale, operazioni di persone e team di ingegneria per stabilire una chiara proprietà, gestire le dipendenze e fornire miglioramenti che rimangono efficaci come Sonar cresce.

Cosa farai

• Architettura di identità e direzione tecnica: Valutare il nostro paesaggio di identità, identificare i rischi materiali e il debito tecnico, e sviluppare una roadmap ingegneristica IAM prioritaria con leadership di squadra e sicurezza dell'informazione..

•
Identity lifecycle engineering:. Collegare dati di forza lavoro autorevoli a piattaforme di identità e applicazioni a valle, con un'identità affidabile corrispondente, riconciliazione, scadenza e gestione delle eccezioni. Fine alla verifica finale dei risultati di deprovisione

•
Autenticazione e federazione: Ingegnere e gestire le integrazioni di SSO, MFA e di provisioning delle applicazioni tramite SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth e SCIM. Autenticazione avanzata resistente al phishing e pratiche di registrazione, recupero e gestione delle sessioni. Gestire certificati federativi e altre dipendenze di scadenza prima di interrompere l'accesso.

•
Governance di accesso: proprio ruolo pratico- e modelli di accesso basati su attributo, flussi di lavoro di approvazione, recensioni di accesso e eccezioni a tempo. Rendere i diritti comprensibili e verificabili, con i proprietari nominati e la separazione appropriata dei doveri. Introdurre l'automazione di prossima generazione per migliorare la velocità e l'accuratezza della supervisione.

•
Automazione e integrazione: Sviluppare codice di qualità della produzione, integrazioni API e codice infrastrutturale per ridurre l'amministrazione manuale. Costruire in test, peer review, esecuzione meno-privilegiata, retries sicuri, riconciliazione e report dei guasti attuabili. Utilizzare l'ingegneria assistita da AI, se utile, con la revisione umana e controlli adeguati alla sensibilità dei cambiamenti di identità.

•
IdentitÃ non umana: Partner con i proprietari di servizi per migliorare l'inventario, la proprietÃ, le autorizzazioni, la rotazione delle credenziali e la pensione dei conti di servizio, le identitÃ delle applicazioni e le credenziali di automazione.

•
Affidabilità e proprietà operativa: Partecipare agli accordi di incidente e di escalation della squadra, diagnosticare guasti complessi e fornire azioni correttive durevoli.

•
Sicurezza e verificabilità: Partner con i proprietari di sicurezza e controllo dell'informazione per implementare i controlli concordati, fornire prove affidabili e risultati ravvicinati attraverso miglioramenti ingegneristici. Collegare la telemetria di identità al monitoraggio della sicurezza, proteggendo i dati di identità sensibili.

•
leadership tecnica e abilitazione: revisione disegni e codice, ingegneri mentore, e aiutare i proprietari di applicazioni adottare modelli di identità supportati. Equipaggiate i team operativi con documentazione e strumenti, quindi le richieste di routine non dipendono dai singoli esperti.

Esperienza e qualifiche

• Servizi di IAM, con un impatto dimostrato: le principali iniziative ambigue e cross-team, la realizzazione di solidi trade-off architettonici e il miglioramento dell'efficacia di altri ingegneri.

•
Esperienza profonda con una moderna piattaforma di identità della forza lavoro come JumpCloud, Okta, o Microsoft Entra ID. L'esperienza JumpCloud è preziosa; la competenza della piattaforma equivalente e la capacità di imparare sono ugualmente rilevanti.

•
Forte comprensione di autenticazione, autorizzazione, federazione, directory e provisioning, tra cui SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, SCIM e WebAuthn/FIDO2.

•
Consegna comprovata dei processi automatizzati del ciclo di vita dell'identità, inclusa l'integrazione dei dati della forza lavoro, la correlazione del conto, i cambiamenti di accesso e la deprovisione verificata in più applicazioni.

•
Esperienza con cloud IAM e accesso federato, in particolare AWS IAM e IAM Identity Center, compresi i limiti di autorizzazione, le credenziali temporanee e i modelli di accesso meno privati.

•
Forte capacità di programmazione e automazione in Python, PowerShell, Go, TypeScript, o un linguaggio paragonabile, insieme a REST API, consegna basata su Git, test automatizzati e infrastruttura-as-code.

•
Esperienza pratica con la governance degli accessi, l'accesso privilegiato, la gestione dei segreti e la produzione di prove che dimostrano i controlli funzionano efficacemente.

•
Esperienza dei servizi business-critical operativi: osservabilità, risposta agli incidenti, analisi root-cause, gestione dei cambiamenti sicuri e test di recupero.

Ulteriori commenti

Questo ruolo è basato a Ginevra. Non siamo in grado di considerare i candidati che non vogliono essere a Ginevra, ma siamo disposti a trasferire il candidato giusto.

Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione

A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano.

Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com .

Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio.

Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.
